description: This file defines the 'UnrecognizedQueryParamException' class, a custom runtime exception used in the Fineract project to indicate unrecognized query parameters in API requests.

classes.name: UnrecognizedQueryParamException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class that captures details about unrecognized query parameters, including the key, value, and supported parameters.

methods.name: UnrecognizedQueryParamException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with the invalid query parameter key, value, and the array of supported parameters.

methods.name: getQueryParamKey
methods.description: Returns the invalid query parameter key that caused the exception.

methods.name: getQueryParamValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the unrecognized query parameter.

methods.name: getSupportedParams
methods.description: Returns the array of supported query parameters for comparison.
